Nora Magnusson  
nora.magnusson@example.com | +47 987 654 321 | Oslo, Norway  

A junior game developer with a focus on SaaS-driven interactive experiences. My work bridges creative vision and technical execution, emphasizing scalable systems and collaborative problem-solving. Over the past two years, I’ve contributed to prototype development, asset automation, and networking solutions within Unreal Engine and Unity environments.  

**Projects**  
*Unreal Physics Prototype (Lumina SaaS, 2023–2024)*  
Designed a physics-driven simulation system for a multiplayer environment, integrating Havok physics components and custom collision resolution. This reduced manual tuning time by 40% and enabled real-time interaction between player avatars. The solution was later adapted into a reusable asset for internal tooling.  

*Unity Asset Pipeline Tool (Nova Games, 2022)*  
Developed a scriptable asset import pipeline using Unity’s Editor API, automating texture compression and metadata tagging. The tool reduced manual setup time for art assets by 60%, streamlining workflows for a team of five. The codebase was later refactored into a modular plugin for broader use.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Junior Game Developer | Lumina SaaS*  
*2023–Present*  
Collaborated on Unreal Engine 5 prototypes for SaaS-based gaming platforms. Implemented basic multiplayer synchronization using Photon Cloud, ensuring low-latency state updates across 10+ concurrent users. Designed a REST API for asset versioning, enabling seamless integration between development and production environments.  

*Game Development Intern | Nova Games*  
*2022*  
Supported project setup for a Unity-based puzzle game, focusing on asset pipeline automation. Wrote custom scripts to batch-process 3D models, reducing import errors and improving artist workflow efficiency. Gained hands-on experience with C# scripting, shader optimization, and version control best practices.  

**Education**  
*Bachelor of Science in Game Development*  
*Norwegian University of Science and Technology*  
*Graduated: 2023*  

**Technical Skills**  
Unreal Engine 5: Developed physics simulations and multiplayer systems.  
Unity: Automated asset pipelines and implemented cross-platform builds.  
C#/.NET: Built networking solutions and REST APIs for SaaS integration.  
Game Physics: Designed collision resolution systems with measurable efficiency gains.  
Game Networking: Implemented synchronization protocols for multiplayer environments.  
REST API Design: Created scalable endpoints for asset management and versioning.  
3D Graphics: Utilized OpenGL-compatible rendering techniques for real-time visual feedback.
